supplementalElfLimit: All six cross-schedule whole-ELF comparisons differ. Required QBE, object, stdout and assembly comparisons pass. readelf on nt-reverse serial01 versus serial02 isolates its single-byte difference to a linker FILE symbol containing the fresh absolute program.o path. Parallel path lengths/build-id metadata also differ; no full-ELF equality or general normalization rule is claimed.

decision.adoption: Retain explicit Node-backed two-process helper as a bounded correctness feasibility experiment; broader worker/lease policy remains unqualified.

limitations: Only two retained regression fixtures and two alternating serial/parallel pairs; no stable confidence interval or whole-campaign speedup.
First serial run is longer than the second; startup/cache/host variation is charged and not isolated.
Guard wallSeconds is a whole selected-workflow scheduling clock; IO.now task overlap uses Date.now wallclock and is diagnostic only.
Aggregate process-tree RSS/disk monitoring is sampled, not a hard kernel quota. No independent per-worker RSS samples were collected.
Root owns exclusive job windows through the existing lock; no reusable throughput-admission/measurement-lease scheduler was implemented.
No native compute workers, parallel heap mutation, GPU, broader effect providers or installed selections were changed.
Campaign cost accounting and retention closure remain root-owned.
